name: capitec-loan-simulator
description: Loan Eligibility Simulator — React + Node, built on Capitec design tokens

scripts.dev: npm run tokens && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,red "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
